HOSPITAL BOARD OF TRUSTEES ELECTIONS. 5 Notwithstanding section 347.9, for elections held pursuant 6 to section 347.9 in 2026, if there are seven trustees on the 7 board and five trustees are to be elected, the four elected who 8 receive the highest number of votes are elected for four-year 9 terms. The remaining trustee is elected for a two-year term. 10 In case of a tie, the county auditor shall determine by lot 11 which of the trustees with the lowest number of winning votes 12 shall serve the two-year term and thereafter their successor 13 shall be elected for regular terms as provided in section 14 347.9. > 15 ______________________________ HARRIS of Appanoose -1- H 8029.2880 (2) 91 ss/ns 1/ 1 #1.
